decision.summary: A broad asymmetric offset-like feature in N and E between indices 523–540: N shows sustained rise then plateau; E shows delayed rise and incomplete return. U is quiet. The absence of a clear opposing return within the allowed context (up to 575) prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain. No other temporary intervals identified in allowed context [485,575].

intervals.observation: N rises steadily from ~523 to ~532, then flattens; E rises more gradually from ~526 to ~534 and shows a partial decline but does not return to pre-event level by 540. U remains within background noise. No clear opposing return observed on either N or E before end of allowed context (575).
